comment: worn.c mon_break_armor() 1225-1226: as in mon_break_armor-tame-orc-shirt-fog-cloud, a tame hill orc dresses in one of the T-shirts ringed around the Priestess (a set of gray dragon scales lies on the first square). She plays a magic flute so it sleeps, puts on a blindfold, and zaps a wand of polymorph at it with monpolycontrol, choosing a hill giant (breakarm). The hero cannot see the square, so the shirt branch prints "You hear a ripping sound." Variation: the blind hero and a breakarm form.
